# Templater

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Create and use dynamic templates with a templating language that inserts variables and functions into notes, along with JavaScript code.

## Scope note

- Provides a consistent structure and layout for specific types of notes.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
